tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and recalled basin mechanism suggest a sink-gradient effect, but the branch and mass drift remain ambiguous. The open-branch probe is the least costly targeted observation for distinguishing these mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the hydraulic basin model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five pilot rows do not identify the branch term or distinguish source-dependent sink strength and external leakage.
The target horizon matches the pilot horizon; resolving the open branch is more directly useful and cheaper.
No pilot evidence requires trajectory-level resolution, and it costs more.
It is not relevant to identifying the proposed mechanism.
